name: ai_studio_latency
description: Span-native latency for AI Studio LLM + agent spans, ordered slowest-first. Trace-scoped on octo-genai-studio so latency is owned by OCI APM (not derived from the Langfuse sync). Pivots to the genai-latency-percentiles Log Analytics search and out to Langfuse/Grafana.
query: show traces SpanName, gen_ai.agent.name as Agent, gen_ai.operation.name as Operation, DurationMs where ServiceName = 'octo-genai-studio' and (SpanName like 'llm.invoke.%' or SpanName like 'agent.invoke.%' or SpanName like 'studio.%' or SpanName = 'vector_db.search' or SpanName = 'retrieval.embed') order by DurationMs desc
